campaign.title: Rename G40_04_PROVIDER while preserving identity and bindings.

initial.code:
FUNCTION G40_04_PROVIDER(X)
  G40_04_PROVIDER = X
  IF (X < 0) THEN
    G40_04_PROVIDER = 0
  END IF
  IF (X > 82) THEN
    G40_04_PROVIDER = 82
  END IF
  G40_04_PROVIDER = G40_04_PROVIDER
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION G40_04_PRED_1(X)
  G40_04_PRED_1 = 0
  IF (G40_04_PROVIDER(X) >= 6) THEN
    G40_04_PRED_1 = 1
  END IF
  G40_04_PRED_1 = G40_04_PRED_1
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION G40_04_PRED_2(X)
  G40_04_PRED_2 = 0
  IF (G40_04_PROVIDER(X) >= 23) THEN
    G40_04_PRED_2 = 1
  END IF
  G40_04_PRED_2 = G40_04_PRED_2
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION G40_04_PRED_3(X)
  G40_04_PRED_3 = 0
  IF (G40_04_PRED_1(X) >= 48) THEN
    G40_04_PRED_3 = 1
  END IF
  G40_04_PRED_3 = G40_04_PRED_3
END FUNCTION
